title: Proactive Degradation Controller and Safe Fallback Routing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: We frequently see short-lived dependency spikes (regional GPU saturation, upstream feature store timeouts, occasionally overloaded model variants) that cause abrupt circuit trips and customer-visible errors. Reactive circuit breakers that only look at instantaneous error rates or 5xx counts tend to oscillate and can cascade across tenants when fallbacks are heavy. Goal: Implement a Proactive Degradation Controller (PDC) that makes safe, gradual degradation decisions per tenant/model/dependency using burn-rate-aware thresholds, percentile latency trends, and workload-aware capacity signals. The PDC will orchestrate soft-degrades (e.g., switch to quantized model, drop non-critical post-processing, reduce streaming chunk size) and safe fallback routing (route to cheaper/compatible model variant, regional replica, or queue + async completion) with explicit rollback windows and metrics gating. Must integrate with Smart Routing and the Console rollout UI for visibility and manual overrides. Constraints: minimal added tail latency, no single global policy that stomps tenant SLAs, respect customer pinning (if customer pins exact model version then only allowed fallback is region-level replica), and maintain audit logs for all degradations. This ticket covers core control loop, config schema, simulation harness, and initial console panels. Implementation is staged: 1) PDC evaluation engine and simulation only; 2) safe degrade actions + metrics; 3) routing integration and canary rollout.
acceptance_criteria: PDC evaluation engine implemented and configurable per tenant/model/dependency via config API
At least three soft-degrade action types implemented (quantized model switch, post-process elision, region-failover) with reversible actions
Thresholds support percentile-based triggers (p50/p95/p99) and error-budget burn rate windows (1m, 5m, 1h)
Simulation harness shows <5% false-positive degradations on historical traces from last 30 days when tuned to default policy
Safe rollback policy implemented: automatic rollback after cool-down unless metrics indicate continued degradation
Console shows per-action events, current PDC state, and one-click manual rollback/force-degrade
End-to-end E2E test that simulates a regional GPU stress causing PDC to route 20% traffic to fallback model and metrics assert no client-visible 5xx spike
Design doc and RFC merged; at least one security review completed if KMS/HSM keys are used for any fallback artifact retrieval
implementation_notes: Control loop uses sliding windows with exponential smoothing to avoid oscillation
Primary signals: error rate, p95 latency, outstanding-requests-per-host, queue length on GPU pools
Decision policy is a weighted score: 0.6*burn_rate + 0.3*p95_delta + 0.1*utilization; tunable per customer
Soft-degrade actions are ordered by invasiveness; always prefer local less-invasive options (post-process elision) before model switch
Respect 'model_pin' metadata: if pinned, restrict action set to non-versioned options or require explicit approval
All actions are emitted as events and stored in audit-log topic; use existing event schema from /events/degradations
Expose a telemetry tag for sampling degraded requests to aid quality analysis (opt-in per customer)
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (sim): run PDC in simulation mode for all live traffic for 7 days, collect triggers and false positives
Phase 1 (canary): enable soft-degrades for internal test tenants (1% global traffic) for 48 hours, monitor key SLOs
Phase 2 (grad): 5% traffic across non-enterprise tenants with nightly review, enable auto-rollback by default
Phase 3 (opt-in): expose feature flag for customers to opt-in to aggressive action set (model switches) with SLA guardrails
Abort criteria: increase in client-visible 5xx > 0.5% absolute or p99 latency increase > 15% sustained for 10 minutes
testing_plan: Unit tests for policy computation and smoothing logic
Simulation test harness replaying historical traces with labelled incidents (include examples from 2025-11-12 outage)
Chaos test that kills region replica and asserts PDC routes per plan and rollbacks correctly
E2E test harness in staging that validates audit logs and console events
Performance benchmark to ensure PDC decision loop adds <500us median to request path when run synchronously; otherwise run async with fast-path cached decisions
